newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Elec shrs fall to limit low.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Elec shrs fall to limit low.

text.p: Samsung Electronics shares went limit down to 62,000 won in mid-afternoon trading on Monday on fears over the global semiconductor market, brokers said.
The sentencing of Lee Kun-hee, the Samsung Group chairman, also depressed investors' sentiment, they added.
Samsung fell 3,900 won or 5.9 percent, with 132,710 shares changing hands.
"Samsung Electronics is weakening because there is talk that the world semiconductor market is getting worse," said a Dongwon Securities broker.
The unit price of 16-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips has fallen about 70 percent in June from a year earlier when it was around $45-$50.
Analysts have said semiconductors account for about 80 percent of Samsung Electronics profits.
Some brokers said investors tended to avoid Samsung Group shares ahead of the sentencing of the group's chairman Lee Kun-hee on bribery charges.
Prosecutors demanded four years in jail for Lee on charges of giving 10 billion won in bribes to former president Roh Tae-woo.
